description: Canonical cross-language (Python/Java) spectral metric and measured LIBS conditioning contract for LIBSDataCurator (TRACK-CORE-01).

metric_definitions.reduced_chi2: (1 / max(n_valid - num_params, 1)) * sum((y_ref_norm - y_pred_norm)^2 / max(var_scaled, eps))

variance_scaling.notes: scale_ref is the normalization denominator computed on masked y_ref; each scaled variance entry is floored by eps before reduced_chi2 summation.

array_length_mismatch.description: Raised when y_ref, y_pred, or any provided optional array (mask, variance, wavelengths_ref, wavelengths_pred) do not share identical 1D lengths.

empty_valid_mask.description: Raised when n_valid == 0 after applying optional boolean mask or when input arrays are empty.

wavelength_mismatch.description: Raised when both wavelengths_ref and wavelengths_pred are supplied and max(abs(wavelengths_ref - wavelengths_pred)) > wavelength_tol.

missing_variance.description: When variance is None/null, reduced_chi2 MUST be None/null (never silently substituting 1.0).

stage_details.apply_lit_and_saturation_mask: Identifies leading unlit detector margin via 3*m0 rule on initial raw mean and masks saturated pixels (>= saturationThresholdFactor * detectorFullScale) without zeroing.
stage_details.dark_subtract: Computes dark_level as median of unlit raw channels (or 0.0 if all lit) and subtracts dark_level from each shot.
stage_details.trim_conditioning_shots: Discards leading laser-conditioning shots per measurement point via Pearson correlation against stable tail mean (clamped to [3, 15], or manifest override).
stage_details.shot_scale_normalize_and_average: Two-pass shot-scale normalization across valid channels to produce mean_spectrum, point_means, and standard error of the mean sigma_mean.
stage_details.apply_morphological_baseline: Post-average morphological grey opening baseline subtraction with configurable se_size followed by max(spectrum - opening, 0.0) clamp.
